name: Glass / glazing
prompt: neutral clear architectural glazing, realistic reflection and transmission, subtle low-e tint; do not turn opaque

name: Curtain panel default
prompt: neutral clear architectural glazing with realistic reflections and low-e tint

name: Window default
prompt: realistic architectural window assembly; transparent glazing with crisp frame boundaries, no invented mullions

name: Black metal
prompt: dark matte powder-coated or anodized architectural metal, subtle roughness, crisp edges

name: Wood
prompt: real wood at believable architectural scale, subtle grain and low-gloss finish; preserve panel and joint boundaries

name: Brick
prompt: real brick masonry with believable module, mortar joints and restrained natural variation

name: Concrete
prompt: architectural concrete with believable scale, subtle pores and restrained variation; no oversized texture

name: Stucco / plaster
prompt: warm-white mineral plaster/stucco or painted gypsum as appropriate, fine realistic texture, matte finish

name: Stone
prompt: real architectural stone at correct slab/tile scale with restrained natural veining and believable joints

name: Tile
prompt: real porcelain/ceramic finish at plausible tile scale with clean grout joints and restrained reflection

name: Metal
prompt: architectural metal with physically plausible roughness/reflection and clean fabrication joints

name: Railings default
prompt: precise architectural metal railing, realistic finish, preserve exact picket/post/guard geometry

name: Vegetation
prompt: natural restrained vegetation, botanically plausible density and scale; do not obscure architecture

name: Water
prompt: physically plausible clean water with realistic reflection/refraction and subtle depth

name: Fabric
prompt: real upholstery/textile with believable weave scale and soft roughness

name: Generic white finish
prompt: neutral realistic architectural finish inferred from element type/name; keep restrained and physically plausible
